I'll calculate the number of days between 2015-12-17 and 2019-02-24.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
from datetime import datetime

date1 = datetime(2015, 12, 17)
date2 = datetime(2019, 2, 24)

difference = date2 - date1
print(f"Days between 2015-12-17 and 2019-02-24: {difference.days}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">date -d "2019-02-24" +%s | xargs -I {} expr {} - $(date -d "2015-12-17" +%s) | xargs -I {} expr {} / 86400</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

**There are 1,165 days** between 2015-12-17 and 2019-02-24.
